quests.title: Optional: A Blank Space on the Clan's Map
quests.text: Our chart leaves the {name:front_wyrmglass_crown/spires} on the Wyrmglass Crown {dir_from_giver:front_wyrmglass_crown/spires} blank, which offends me as a dwarf and a keeper of records. Reach the island by boat; the Shipwright at our stables sells them. Keep to the shelf and the channel on the crossing, away from the Kraken's deep water. Kill six Crown Crag Eagles on those spires by day so a surveyor can look at the stone without being pecked for it.
quests.lesson: Island trip by boat; coin at the cap, no XP.

quests.title: Group: Silence for the Clan
quests.text: There's an elite stone golem, {name:rime_bell_warden}, guarding the {name:front_wyrmglass_crown/spires} {dir_from_giver:rime_bell_warden}, and the clan wants its bell silenced. Gather a full group, take a boat each to the Wyrmglass Crown and destroy the golem. I've a payment ready and a space in the record for everyone who comes back.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite on the island.

quests.title: Bounty: The Clan's Standing Order
quests.text: The clan has placed another order for Rime Sinew, with an impressive number of signatures from dwarves staying home. Take a boat to the Wyrmglass Crown and hunt Rimehorn Rams by day on the {name:front_wyrmglass_crown/scree}. Bring me four Rime Sinew for payment. You can take this bounty again one hour after each turn-in; I'll keep the signatories busy finding your coin.
quests.lesson: Island salvage bounty: coin at the cap.

quests.title: Optional: Wrong Ink on the Survey
quests.text: Somebody pressed a branded coin into the capstone of the survey cairn at {name:r20_anchor_075} on the Wyrmglass Crown, as if to sign the island into their own books. Take a boat from the Shipwright at our stables, keep to the shelf and the channel, and pry the coin out. The clan's records have no line for a debt to the ground itself, and I intend to keep it that way.

objectives.label: Pry the brand-coin from the survey cairn

quests.lesson: Optional island extension of the main line (chapter 3 on): one use, coin only.
